_doc: Accounts (GDD 4.16, 4.18, D15) [balance]. ledger_detail_years: years of detailed entries kept (2 years = 16 days); older entries are summed into ledger.summaries by year, category and building. ledger_days_view: days of the 'by day' tab. notices_keep_years: a notice older than this goes away (at dawn). loan_warn_days: urgent notices when the loan (or its extension) falls due within these days. upkeep_damage_days: days of unpaid upkeep after which the building becomes damaged (D15 = b); it goes back to normal when the debt is settled.
